an8.88:1.1: 106 aṭṭhahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamānā upāsakā appasādaṃ pavedeyyuṃ.
an8.88:1.3: gihīnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati gihīnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati gihī akkosati paribhāsati gihī gihīhi vibhedeti buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tato ca devā naṃ passanti.
an8.88:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamānā upāsakā appasādaṃ pavedeyyuṃ. 107
an8.88:2.1: aṭṭhahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamānā upāsakā pasādaṃ pavedeyyuṃ.
an8.88:2.3: na gihīnaṃ alābhāya parisakkati na gihīnaṃ anatthāya parisakkati na gihī akkosati paribhāsati na gihī gihīhi vibhedeti buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati tato ca devā naṃ passanti.
an8.88:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgatassa bhikkhuno ākaṅkhamānā upāsakā pasādaṃ pavedeyyunti.
